gate: SLWM-v4 Gate 2 — Pre-Registered Cross-Model Showcase Manifest (AGENTS.md §13.2)

global_protocol.dev_vs_sealed_test_separation: dev gallery used during V4-S3/V4-S4 iteration; sealed_test gallery generated ONCE after checkpoint and decoding hyperparameters are frozen.

deterministic_quantile_selector.seed_selection_rule: Rank episodes on the median training seed by each track's pre-registered physical grounding metric; never drop P05 failures.

causal_conditioning_interventions.av_condition_shuffling: Pair identical video with symmetric +-0.96 s interior-cropped audio from same clip (zero splice seam, MOD_TEXT stripped) to verify causal AV conditioning vs unconditional prior hallucination.
causal_conditioning_interventions.robotics_action_intervention: Compare two valid joint-limit-respecting in-distribution motor programs (0.0% joint-limit violation, NEVER OOD negated -a) to verify causal action-to-video controllability.
causal_conditioning_interventions.generative_head_non_inferiority_gate: Adding Flow-Video + Depth-Audio heads must NOT regress closed-loop ALOHA Stage 2/3, >30s overwrite/re-ID recall, or PolicyCommitGate ECE beyond pre-registered 1.0% / 0.015 bounds.

track_a_video_to_audio_impact_and_foley.description: Causal Video -> Audio contact & open-domain Foley synthesis (160 ms interleaved, 16-RVQ Mimi).

track_b_audio_and_text_to_video_generati.description: Causal Audio -> Video and Text -> Video Flow-Matching generation (192x320 @ 25 fps, 4-8 NFE).

track_c_2min_plus_live_continuous_av_act.description: Sustainable >= 120.0 s (750 heartbeats) continuous live simultaneous Audio+Video+Action generation in flat O(1) VRAM.

track_d_closed_loop_humanoid_and_robotic.description: Closed-loop MuJoCo ALOHA manipulation (TransferCube + Insertion) + DROID held-out building + Unitree G1/H1 held-out sessions + AgiBot held-out task/scenes.

track_e_blind_av_desync_and_policy_commi.description: 5-action PolicyCommitGate calibration (ECE < 0.05), clean grounded accuracy (>= 85%), clean abstention (<= 10%), and blind-desync/OOD abstention (>= 70%).
